summary: StageLink Iteration 2 — action-based architecture pivot fully validated. Backend: 19/19 new-entity tests pass (bands, equipment, studios, lessons, community posts w/ like+comment toggle, /entities/mine, action-based gigs/applications with no role gate, active-role auto-adds missing role, seeded users have BOTH roles). Frontend: Login as ariya.kapoor lands on Home tab showing greeting, quick metrics (Applications/Rating/Followers), Upcoming gigs (Rooftop Jazz Night), 'Picked for you' recos, and Community feed with 4+ posts. All 5 bottom tabs render (Home/Discover/Create/Messages/Profile). Discover has all 7 chips (Gigs/Musicians/Bands/Studios/Equipment/Lessons/Venues) and switching to Bands renders 3 seeded bands (via /api/bands). Create tab shows all 7 action cards (post, hiring, band, equipment_rent, equipment_sale, studio, lesson). Community post creation via Create tab POSTs to /api/posts and shows in feed on refresh. Equipment rent listing publishes successfully. Messages tab shows seeded thread with Sunset Sound Co; opening /chat/[id] and sending a message posts to /api/messages. Profile role switcher toggles active_role musician <-> organizer via /api/auth/active-role and the profile view refreshes (organizer view shows different sections: My applications & gigs / Insights / My listings 7 / Upgrade to Pro). Like button toggle on community post works (heart fills and count increments 0->1). New user signup flow correctly skips /auth/role and routes directly to /auth/onboarding (confirmed in _layout.tsx line 32-35). Non-blocking: deprecated pointerEvents warning still present (carried over from iteration 1).

integration_issues.issue: After creating a post from Create tab, navigating back to Home does NOT auto-refetch /posts/feed — new post only appears after pull-to-refresh or full reload. Review request explicitly says 'visible on refresh' so this is acceptable, but a focus/useFocusEffect-based refetch on Home would improve UX.

react_native_issues.component: Pressable (unknown source, likely third-party in expo-router/react-navigation)
react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still present. Reference: (carried over from iteration_1)

action_items: (Cleanup) Remove stale comment in /app/frontend/app/auth/signup.tsx line 26 that says 'AuthGate routes to /auth/role' — the /auth/role step has been removed (_layout.tsx now routes directly to /auth/onboarding for authenticated users with onboarded=false).
(UX polish) Add useFocusEffect-based refetch on Home tab (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx) so newly-created community posts appear when the user tabs back to Home without pull-to-refresh.
(Cleanup, carried over) Track down 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning and migrate to style.pointerEvents.
(No action needed — everything else works as spec.)
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/auth/active-role now auto-adds the requested role to user.roles if missing (server.py L317-326). This is correct action-based behavior — no 400 on role mismatch anymore.
Backend do_seed() (server.py L741, L775) sets roles=['organizer','musician'] and roles=['musician','organizer'] for all seeded users — dual-role verified by tests.

Backend /api/posts/feed correctly annotates each post with liked flag (per-user) and preserves like_count/comment_count from the post document — no ObjectId leakage (all queries use projection {'_id': 0}).
Backend _list_entity helper unifies band/equipment/studio/lesson list queries — good DRY pattern.
server.py is now ~1123 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/entities.py, routers/community.py, routers/ai.py for maintainability.
Frontend (tabs)/create.tsx setTimeout(reset, 900) after success is fine for UX but means create-ok testID is only visible for <1s — tests must check within that window.

Frontend Discover chip Pressables occasionally do not receive Playwright force-click events reliably (had to fall back to element.click() via JS). Real device touches work. Consider migrating touch-critical Pressables to TouchableOpacity or explicit hitSlop for testing determinism.
